detailed_descriptions.en: FEATURES: AUTO-BATTLER WITH TENS OF THOUSANDS OF UNITS INCREMENTAL GAMEPLAY WITH HUNDREDS OF UPGRADES TO UNLOCK 30 LEVELS WITH EVER-GROWING UNDEAD HORDES FULLY VOICED BANTER BETWEEN KING RICHARD AND NECROMANCER MORIANA You are King Richard, and the evil necromancess Moriana has invaded your realm. Gather your army and defeat the invaders… before they behead you. Fight through 30 levels , each a bigger threat to your castle walls than the last. Recruit peasants, archers, knights, cavalry, mages, and more until TENS OF THOUSANDS of units clash on the battlefield. Earn gold by slaying undead enemies and spend it on buildings that send more and more soldiers onto the battlefield. The rest is in their hands… and swords. Watch them die in your name as they try to stop the immense waves of zombies. Use the souls of defeated foes to unlock new units and improvements between levels , strengthening both your colossal armies and your castle walls. Tip the scales in your favor with hundreds of upgrades waiting to be unlocked , and grow stronger with every battle. Unlock special abilities to unleash chaos upon your enemies. Man your walls with ranged units, summon tornadoes, or even… explode sheep! Relax and unwind in this fantasy incremental auto-battler while your loyal and devoted troops fight for you. Fill the screen with your armies, rule the battlefield, and don’t let your enemies get anywhere near your precious castle!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
FEATURES:

  • AUTO-BATTLER WITH TENS OF THOUSANDS OF UNITS

  • INCREMENTAL GAMEPLAY WITH HUNDREDS OF UPGRADES TO UNLOCK

  • 30 LEVELS WITH EVER-GROWING UNDEAD HORDES

  • FULLY VOICED BANTER BETWEEN KING RICHARD AND NECROMANCER MORIANA

You are King Richard, and the evil necromancess Moriana has invaded your realm. Gather your army and defeat the invaders… before they behead you.

Fight through 30 levels, each a bigger threat to your castle walls than the last. Recruit peasants, archers, knights, cavalry, mages, and more until TENS OF THOUSANDS of units clash on the battlefield.

Earn gold by slaying undead enemies and spend it on buildings that send more and more soldiers onto the battlefield. The rest is in their hands… and swords. Watch them die in your name as they try to stop the immense waves of zombies.

Use the souls of defeated foes to unlock new units and improvements between levels, strengthening both your colossal armies and your castle walls. Tip the scales in your favor with hundreds of upgrades waiting to be unlocked, and grow stronger with every battle.

Unlock special abilities to unleash chaos upon your enemies. Man your walls with ranged units, summon tornadoes, or even… explode sheep!

Relax and unwind in this fantasy incremental auto-battler while your loyal and devoted troops fight for you. Fill the screen with your armies, rule the battlefield, and don’t let your enemies get anywhere near your precious castle!
